executive_summary.strengths: Seven distinct themed ideas plus matching structural box options, retail presentation tips, brand identity and practical pitfalls.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Promises sales impact and perfect production without proof; food-contact packaging requirements are underexplained; extensive awkward copy and repeated claims weaken technical and editorial credibility.
